subject: Contract rollforward + EU/APAC capacity onramp
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novahealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Contract rollforward + EU/APAC capacity onramp

Elena —

Thanks for the renewal heads-up. Per our last call I put together a short proposal to roll forward the current term and add dedicated pools in EU and APAC to remove tail latency for your regional customers. High-level: 12-month extension to match your fiscal year, add 40 dedicated GPUs for the EU pool and 24 GPUs for APAC (NVIDIA A100 equivalent), and a throughput floor of 110K tokens/min sustained per pool with burst to 160K for business hours.

Attached: draft SOW (NovaHealth_Dedicated_SOW_v1.pdf) and a capacity runbook stub. Two asks for today:
- Confirm the GPU counts above (or your target QPS/concurrency).
- Confirm latency SLOs you care about (p95 / p99 targets) and whether cross-region failover is required for stateful traffic.

If helpful I can loop in Karthik (technical lead) and Lauren (pricing) to a short call next week to lock the amendment language and timeline.

Best,
Rishi
---
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
[Attachment: NovaHealth_Dedicated_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novahealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: salesops@novahealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Contract rollforward + EU/APAC capacity onramp

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear starting point. A few clarifications from our ops side:
- GPU counts: EU 40 / APAC 24 looks reasonable as a starting commit. We'll validate with traffic slices but that's the target.
- Latency SLOs: we need p95 < 120ms in EU and p95 < 150ms in APAC for our interactive product. Can you confirm those are achievable with the reserved pools + KV caching?
- Failover: we require regional failover for catastrophic regional outages (max RTO 48 hours). For normal edge-level outages we expect smart routing to route to the nearest pool; for stateful sessions we want a documented fallback plan.

Also can you include a short paragraph in the SOW about data handling (logs retention 90 days, audit logs export to our S3) and an optional clause for burst capacity pricing? I've copied Sales Ops to coordinate procurement timelines.

—Elena
Elena Gomez
Director of Platform Ops, NovaHealth
elena.gomez@novahealth.com
[Inline: salesops@novahealth.com]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novahealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Contract rollforward + EU/APAC capacity onramp

Elena — thanks, that's helpful. Quick answers and next steps:

- Latency: Karthik ran a narrow microbenchmark on the proposed configuration. With prefix KV caching and the A100-equivalent profiles we're seeing p95 in the EU pool around 85–110ms and p99 around 200–250ms for interactive 1k-token workloads; APAC is ~20–40ms higher depending on region egress. I'll attach the short runbook with the test notes.

- Failover: we support cross-region fallback via a policy-based router. For stateful sessions we'll include an opt-in KV replication option (adds a small storage/replication fee) and a documented 48-hour RTO playbook. See capacity_runbook_v2.xlsx.

- SOW updates: Lauren will propose language for log retention (90 days), audit export, and the burst pricing tier.

Propose a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize amendment language and a procurement timeline; I've opened a DocuSign envelope for the term amendment and included a placeholder for the GPU commit.

Best,
Rishi
[Attachment: capacity_runbook_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: Sizing and SLA language suggestions (NovaHealth)

Team — internal note before tomorrow's call:
- Recommend we tie the throughput floor to tokens/min per pool rather than GPU count in the SOW: proposal: 120k sustained tokens/min EU, 100k sustained tokens/min APAC, with burst to 160k / 140k respectively. That gives NovaHealth predictability and lets us manage GPU placement.
- SLA: propose p95 latency SLOs (EU < 115ms, APAC < 150ms) and a separate availability SLI of 99.6% for the dedicated pools. Keep the RTO language (48 hrs) and add an optional faster escalation path (+1 SLA credit) for critical outages.
- Pricing: Lauren — add a tiered discount for multi-region commit (5% at commit, additional 3% at 18-month commit).

I'll prep a clean SOW paragraph and hand to Lauren to insert price table. Monica — please prep an onboarding checklist for cross-region routing and KV replication.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
[Internal attachment referenced: internal_performance_notes.txt]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novahealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, salesops@novahealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 18:02:00 -0400
Subject: Final: agreed next steps and DocuSign link (NVH-4231)

Elena / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary and next steps below: 

Agreed scope
- Term: 12-month rollforward (aligns to FY28).
- Commit: EU pool 40 GPUs / APAC pool 24 GPUs (operationalized as throughput floor: EU 120k tokens/min sustained, APAC 100k tokens/min sustained; burst values in SOW).
- SLOs: p95 EU < 115ms, p95 APAC < 150ms; availability SLI 99.6%.
- Failover: documented 48-hour RTO for region-level outage; optional KV replication add-on for stateful session continuity.
- Data handling: log retention 90 days; audit export to your S3 bucket (details in SOW).

Action items
- NovaHealth: confirm procurement contact and internal PO timeline (salesops@novahealth.com).
- Redwood: Lauren to issue updated SOW with pricing tiers and multi-region discount language; Karthik/Monica to finalize runbook and onboarding checklist.
- Signatures: DocuSign envelope open here: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123456789 (placeholder). Please sign by EOD next Wednesday to hit an Aug 1 start.

I'll schedule the 30-min alignment tomorrow to walk through SOW line-by-line (invite sent).

Thanks — looking forward to getting NovaHealth on multi-region Dedicated.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
